_comment: Failure labels (findings.py) the requirement-severity tests are known to fail with at the head they were last run against.
Used only with PPDS_DIFF_XFAIL=1: a test whose failures all carry these labels is reported as xfail.
A failure with any other label, or 'unlabelled', still fails. Remove a label when its fix lands.

labels.new-xargs-options: round 4: xargs / parallel with their own options in front of the program, the words of a switch, target or write on stdin (e.g. echo select --environment <unlisted> | xargs -n 9 ppds env passes even with an unlisted active environment)
labels.new-hidden-words: round 4: switch or target words in the text but not as whole words (printf escapes feeding xargs, an exported assignment used in bash -c)
labels.new-unknown-wrapper: round 4: a wrapper the reader does not know in front of a shell given code (setsid, busybox sh, ...), program from a substitution
labels.new-home-override: round 4: HOME changed in front of the CLI, so it reads another profile store (~/.ppds)
labels.new-sql-exponent-glue: round 4: a SQL write word glued to a numeric literal with an exponent marker (SELECT 1.5eDELETE ...)
labels.cost-rule-false-block: round 4: an ordinary command that only mentions a program next to option-looking words is refused with a listed environment (grep ppds -rE docs, Get-Process ppds -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
labels.r2-target-override: reappears only together with a round-4 label (an override reached through xargs or hidden words)
labels.r2-profile-override: reappears only together with a round-4 label
labels.r2-version-update: reappears only together with a round-4 label (echo --update | xargs -n 1 ppds version)
labels.new-shell-feed: reappears only together with a round-4 label (wrapper or HOME in front of a shell given code)
labels.new-switch-behind-runtime-program: reappears only together with a round-4 label (unknown wrapper)
